title: MultiRoute Functionalities
description:
Multiroute is the routing and truck logistics software of multisystem. I added a lot of pictures with different things I created and modified.

These are some of them.

I created a stepper component that notified the state if deliveries and it's stops rendering a colorful timeline. They could also see what was inside he invoice, their amount and units(cases, pounds and such).

I modified our surveys capabilities to be non linear or sequential. Different responses lead to different questions.

Implemented inter azure map location fetch at the Routing by Map functionality.

I created access profiles so user configuration was faster.

I optimized a file fetching module that used to get stuck due to the amount of files by adding a date range functionality and a backend type fetch. with both combined the page loaded way faster than before.
